stories.title: 7-year-old's grief support puppy goes missing months after losing her mother
stories.summary: The McDonough family believes someone may have taken the 3-month-old puppy, who was meant to help the little girl cope with the death of her mother.

stories.title: Macon man rides hundreds of miles with broken bones, collapsed lung to finish Baja 1000
stories.summary: Ben Lefholz, 33, crashed 430 miles into the grueling race, but rode through his injuries to reach the finish line. Now, he's recovering at home for the holidays.

stories.title: Tyler Perry Studios replaces Washington state fire station's sign after filming at location
stories.summary: ​According to the fire department, the Atlanta-based film studio agreed to replace its sign, which has not been lit up in at least 10 years.

stories.title: Woman reported missing along with 2 young girls located, Rockdale County deputies say
stories.summary: The woman and the two girls were located without any injuries.

stories.title: 11 residents displaced by fire on night before Thanksgiving in DeKalb County
stories.summary: One person was taken to the hospital to be treated for minor injures, the fire department said.

stories.title: Lawrenceville Police locate family after finding child
stories.summary: The department earlier Thursday put out a notice trying to identify the child.

stories.title: Lanes back open after deadly crash, another collision on I-285 SB in DeKalb County Thanksgiving morning
stories.summary: There were two crashes causing backups on I-285 SB in DeKalb County on Thursday, Nov. 26.

stories.title: 1 dead, another hurt in 'intentional crash and shooting' in Woodstock, police say
stories.summary: This scene unfolded on Highway 92 at Hames Road around 5:10 p.m.

stories.title: 72-year-old Newnan man left without a home after car crashes into rental property
stories.summary: Weeks after a car slammed into his home, the property was condemned. Now, Andrew Kidd is staying with friends and trying to figure out what comes next.

stories.title: 2 arrested in Gwinnett County after kidnapping victim slips note to business employees, police say
stories.summary: Police say Guillermo Gonzalez was abducted in South Carolina over a drug-related financial dispute before alerting workers at two local businesses.

stories.title: Police: Suspect on the run after armed robbery at Sandy Springs bank; FBI leading investigation
stories.summary: Police say an armed man demanded money and fled with a large amount of cash from Center State Bank on Sandy Springs Circle.

stories.title: Raccoon attacked by dog in Snellville tests positive for rabies, officials say
stories.summary: Anyone who may have been scratched or bitten by any stray animals or suspected rabid animals should seek medical care immediately.
